title: ApplianceCommandMessage
description: Topic B: freedriver/v1/{instanceId}/commands (retain=false, QoS 1). Isolation is instanceId (UUIDv4), not a board and not the MQTT client-id. applianceName is the alias key. Boards are not on this wire. Schema 2 replaces v1 (never live-commanded).

instanceId.description: Autonomy instance UUIDv4 (8-4-4-4-12). Not the MQTT protocol client-id. Rejects /, +, #.
